veld-pt-driehoek.uitleg: Pass to the player at the next cone and sprint after your ball to that cone. The receiver takes their first touch towards the next cone and plays on. After a few minutes, change direction.
veld-pt-driehoek.organisatie: Triangle of about 9 m with three disc cones. Two players with the ball at the starting cone, one player at each of the other two.
coachpunten: Receive with your back foot, body open to the next cone
Pass to your teammate's correct foot (the one they want to receive with)
Accelerate straight after your pass

moeilijker: One-touch passing
Add a second ball
Receive with the outside of the foot

veld-pt-y-vorm.uitleg: A passes to B, B lays it back and A plays it long to C (left) or D (right). Then rotate: A to B's spot, B to C, C dribbles back to the start. The next round goes to the other side.
veld-pt-y-vorm.organisatie: Start cone A; B 7 m straight ahead; C and D 6 m further on, 5 m to the left and right (Y-shape). Start with 4–6 players; extra players wait at A.
coachpunten: B: move away from the cone first, then come short to receive
Lay it back onto A's running foot so they can play it first time
Long pass firm and in front of the receiver

makkelijker: B controls first and then passes back
moeilijker: Everything one-touch
C/D also lays it back to B arriving (third man)
Two balls: left and right alternately
After the lay-off, C plays B in behind and B finishes on the big goal

veld-pt-rebounder.uitleg: Pass against the rebounder (or a wall) and move sideways while the ball is travelling. Control the return with the inside of your foot and play it back with the other foot. That way you shuttle between two spots.
veld-pt-rebounder.organisatie: Rebounder or wall 7 m away. Two disc cones 4 m apart mark the width. One player per rebounder; with more players, take turns of 30 seconds.
coachpunten: Be balanced every time before you receive the ball
Inside of the foot, ankle locked, standing foot next to the ball
Alternate left and right foot

makkelijker: Stay in one spot, 4 m away
moeilijker: Play it back first time
10 m away and harder
After each pass, turn round a cone behind you
After three passes, take the ball and score in a mini goal

veld-pt-lange-bal.uitleg: A plays a long, lofted ball to B in the area on the other side. B controls it out of the air, takes it with them inside the area and plays it long back. A ball that lands in the area scores a point. Suitable from U13.
veld-pt-lange-bal.organisatie: Two 6 × 6 m areas 25 m apart (15–20 m for younger players). One player in each area; with more players, queues behind the areas.
coachpunten: Standing foot beside and slightly behind the ball, strike the bottom of it with your laces
Lean back slightly and follow through towards your target
Receiver: read the flight early and take it in your running direction

moeilijker: Distance 30–35 m
First touch straight out of the area (take it with you)
Cross-field ball: from the side to a player making a run

veld-pt-poortjesspel.uitleg: Pairs pass the ball to each other through a gate: every good pass through a gate is a point. Then you have to pick a different gate. Which pair has the most points after 1.5 minutes?
veld-pt-poortjesspel.organisatie: 18 × 17 m area with 5 gates of two disc cones (1.5 m wide). Pairs with one ball; all pairs play at the same time.
coachpunten: Off the ball: move to the other side of a free gate in good time
On the ball: look up and pick a gate where your partner is already waiting
Pass firmly and along the ground

makkelijker: The same gate twice is allowed
moeilijker: Two touches maximum
A tagger or defender who can intercept passes
Pass with the weaker foot only
After passing through the gate, keep running: your partner plays it back into your path

veld-pt-vierhoek-twee-ballen.uitleg: Four players on the corners of a square, two balls on opposite corners. Both balls go round at the same time: receive with your back foot towards the next corner and play on. On the whistle, the direction changes.
veld-pt-vierhoek-twee-ballen.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square with a cone on each corner. Players stand just inside the cone. Two balls with players on opposite corners.
coachpunten: Stay open: body facing the ball and the next corner
Receive with your back foot, in one movement onto your passing foot
Watch the second ball: talk and play in time

moeilijker: One-touch passing
Follow your pass to the next corner
Add a third ball

veld-cv-derde-man-afronden.uitleg: Player 1 passes into player 2, who comes short and lays it back. Meanwhile player 3 (the third man) runs in behind the defender. Player 1 plays them in first time and player 3 finishes.
veld-cv-derde-man-afronden.organisatie: Triangle of about 8 m, 20–28 m from goal, mannequin as a defender at 15 m. Rotate after each attack: 1 becomes 2, 2 becomes 3, 3 joins the ball.
coachpunten: Player 2: come short and lay it back first time
Third man: only start when the ball reaches player 2, then go flat out
Through ball into the run, not to feet

makkelijker: Player 3 starts before the first pass
moeilijker: A defender instead of the mannequin
Everything one-touch
After the shot, player 1 defends a second attack
